nodes.label: Flower start_simulation Over ServerApp/flwr run
nodes.rationale: Flower's simulation mode (virtual clients in one process) was chosen over literal Docker-per-hospital or the newer ServerApp/flower-superlink deployment model because it is standard practice in published FL research and avoids networking/ops complexity for a free-tier-compute, PyTorch-still-learning team. This is a legitimate simplification, not a corner cut -- Docker is mentioned only as a future-deployment discussion paragraph.
